[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In today's ledger, a quiet `⏭ N` mark after a Task Link forecasts [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the `Keep ‹N› moving` successor picker that closing that task will [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]it appears only on the link whose close triggers the group, and it [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is silent whenever that cannot be proven. Keep-moving first stops [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]skipping standalone top-level projects (only umbrella projects are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]skipped), so the screenshot's `job_email_recruiters` link shows `⏭ [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]4` and Ctrl+Enter then offers those same four tasks.[/#D7D7AF]
